retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style group portrait framed by a thick purple border and a thin red inner stroke, featuring a prominent gold script logo at the top.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover with purple border

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a four-person group portrait in warm, low-key lighting, encased in a wide purple frame with a thin red double-line border. A metallic gold, cursive script logo is positioned in the upper third, overlapping the dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: The purple border acts as a primary container for the central photograph.
The gold script logo provides a high-contrast focal point against the dark upper background.
The subjects are arranged in a triangular formation with one central figure in white.
Warm skin tones and earth-toned clothing contrast with the cool purple frame.
coreInvariants: Thick purple outer border with thin red inner pinstripe
Gold metallic script typography with swash flourishes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the white shirt with red floral accents.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright gold logo at the top, down to the central figure, then outward to the flanking band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, indistinct background behind the subjects provides space for the logo.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold (typography) and bright red (pinstripe and floral details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm saturation in the photo contrasted with high-saturation purple and gold.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes on the first and last letters
Variable stroke width with thick downstrokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' and 'G' feature large, circular loops that frame the word
The 'd' has a long, sweeping tail that underlines the text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone decorative script; no secondary typeface used.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual but flowing 70s energy
Necessary to replicate the specific interlocking loops

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s style group portrait of four men with long hair and moustaches, wearing plaid and denim, in warm soft lighting against a dark background. Frame the image with a thick purple border and a thin red inner pinstripe.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a gold metallic script logo in the top center with large decorative swashes on the initial and final letters.

verificationChecks: Is the purple border thick and prominent?
Does the logo have a metallic gold appearance?
Is the photography style warm and slightly soft-focus?
Are the red pinstripes present inside the purple border?

mustRedesign: Clean, high-definition sharp edges in the photo

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color cast
Hand-drawn quality to the script logo

postGenerationChecks: Check for the thin red pinstripe detail.
Ensure the gold logo is legible against the dark background.
Verify the subjects' attire matches the 1970s era.
Confirm the purple border is perfectly square.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Band Portrait = (Warm Film Photography + Group Pose) + (Thick Purple Border + Red Pinstripe) + (Gold Script Logo Overlay)
